nodes.label: Milestone 3 — Features and Scoring
nodes.rationale: M3 closes the gap left by M2's ingestion layer by building the three-dimension scoring pipeline (Growth, Demand, Novelty). Design choice: idempotency via delete-then-insert avoids schema changes to NicheScoreHistory. Percentile normalisation returns neutral 50 for niches with < 2 days of history.

nodes.label: ADR-004 — Three-dimension scoring design
nodes.rationale: Documents weights (0.41/0.35/0.24), percentile rank over 30-day rolling window per niche, and spike-alert logic.

nodes.label: Milestone 4 — Agent Graph (LangGraph)
nodes.rationale: Builds linear LangGraph pipeline: fetcher→retriever→forecaster→reporter→reviewer. Headline is programmatic, summary is LLM-generated. Reviewer is heuristic-only. LLM adapter injected at build time.

nodes.label: agent nodes — fetcher, retriever, forecaster, reporter, reviewer
nodes.norm_label: agent nodes — fetcher, retriever, forecaster, reporter, reviewer

nodes.label: ADR-005 — Agent graph design (LangGraph)
nodes.rationale: Linear graph, no conditional edges. Forecaster reads NicheScoreHistory, cold-starts via score_niche. Headline programmatic to avoid JSON-schema fragility. Reviewer heuristic-only, never retries. Persistence in orchestrator.

nodes.label: Milestone 5 — Full Telegram Bot
nodes.rationale: Implements /briefing, /niches, /niche, /trending bot commands and scheduler-driven push (daily digest, spike alerts). Spike alert chained inside _scoring_job to avoid race with stale data.

nodes.label: ADR-006 — Daily digest delivery and spike-alert chaining
nodes.rationale: Spike alert awaited inside _scoring_job to avoid race. Digest targets telegram_allowed_chat_ids. Per-chat failures logged but don't abort. Bot reference injected into build_scheduler.
nodes.norm_label: adr-006 — daily digest delivery and spike-alert chaining

nodes.label: Bulk Backfill on Empty DB at Startup
nodes.rationale: Solves cold-start problem: on empty DB, pulls 30 days of history, rebuilds NicheSignal by binning SourceItems by created_at, scores day-by-day. Subsequent restarts are no-ops.

nodes.rationale: Rich multi-bar live display driven by a custom structlog processor watching existing log events. Keeps pipeline stages untouched.

nodes.label: Plan — v4.C Review Fixes
nodes.rationale: Two breaking bugs: embedding_model never set on PainPoint (ADR-011 isolation dead code), brief generation KeyError on real adapters (v3 keys). Both silent in CI.

nodes.label: Plan — Backfill Dry-Run Token Estimator
nodes.rationale: Adds --dry-run to run_backfill.py: runs ingestion phase normally, then estimates LLM token cost via char/4 heuristic (±20%), does not mutate pipeline state.

nodes.label: Plan — Add OpenAI (GPT-4.1 nano) as LLM provider
nodes.rationale: OpenAI as fourth provider (ollama, nim, mock, openai). model_name uses openai: prefix to isolate extraction cache per ADR-011. Uses SDK beta.chat.completions.parse for structured output.
nodes.norm_label: plan — add openai (gpt-4.1 nano) as llm provider

nodes.label: CI/CD Plan A — Containerize with Docker + docker-compose (SQLite)
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Dockerfile with python:3.12-slim + official uv image. Single app service with devtrend_db named volume. Postgres migration deferred to Plan D.
nodes.norm_label: ci/cd plan a — containerize with docker + docker-compose (sqlite)

nodes.label: Plan — Reddit Connector Migration to PullPush.io
nodes.rationale: Replaces public Reddit JSON API (WAF blocked on datacenter IPs) with PullPush.io (1000 req/hour, unauthenticated). normalize() unchanged; external_id prefixed with t3_ for dedup parity.
nodes.norm_label: plan — reddit connector migration to pullpush.io

nodes.label: Plan — Reddit Connector Rate Limiting and Request Hygiene
nodes.rationale: Enforces global ≤10 req/min by spacing calls 6s apart. Graceful 429/403 handling: log + skip remaining subs + no immediate retry.
nodes.norm_label: plan — reddit connector rate limiting and request hygiene

nodes.label: Reddit Atom/RSS Feed Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Reddit's JSON API blocks datacenter IPs via TLS fingerprinting (JA3/JA4). The /new.rss endpoint sits on a different code path and returns 200. Chosen because it is frozen-stable for 15+ years and has no auth requirement.

nodes.label: RedditRateLimited (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed because the RSS endpoint does not exhibit 403/429 failure modes. Per-sub graceful skip subsumes the abort behavior.

nodes.label: Per-sub Graceful Degradation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Any per-sub HTTP error or malformed XML logs a structured warning and continues with the next sub. Replaces the previous abort-on-error flow.

nodes.label: structlog ProcessorFormatter Unification
nodes.rationale: Single root handler with ProcessorFormatter unifies stdlib logs (uvicorn, APScheduler, telegram) and structlog-originated logs into one JSON stream. log_config=None on uvicorn.run() prevents uvicorn from overwriting the setup.

nodes.label: Mute Noisy Third-Party Loggers
nodes.rationale: uvicorn.access, httpx, httpcore, telegram, telegram.ext are pinned to WARNING. httpx leaks the Telegram bot token in URLs, making this also a security fix.

nodes.label: ^view: CallbackQueryHandler Registration
nodes.rationale: The ^view: callback was emitted by all emitters but had no registered handler, so the 📄 details button silently did nothing.

nodes.label: False 0-repos-found Validation Bug
nodes.rationale: Triggered by 3 layered failures: (a) keyword extraction picked filler tokens while dropping cohort nouns like 'adhd', (b) GitHub query ANDed 5 keywords so almost no repo matched, (c) repo_count=0 was scored as 30/100 'validated novel' instead of no-signal.

nodes.label: Validation PR1 - Multi-query GitHub Search + Keyword Extraction
nodes.norm_label: validation pr1 - multi-query github search + keyword extraction

nodes.label: extract_keywords (tighter stopword filtering)
nodes.rationale: Audience-derived tokens emitted first so cohort identifiers like 'adhd' survive the 5-token cap. Expanded _STOPWORDS removes filler terms like 'current', 'existing', 'apps', 'users'.

nodes.label: _pair_queries multi-query GitHub search
nodes.rationale: Replaces single AND-of-5 query (almost no repo matched) with up to three 2-keyword union queries over the top 4 keywords, deduped by full_name, sorted by stars.

nodes.label: validation_curve returning None for zero repos
nodes.rationale: An empty GitHub result more often means the search missed something than that the idea is genuinely unexplored. Treating as no-signal drops the validation dimension from the weighted total and renormalizes remaining 4 dimensions.
nodes.norm_label: validation_curve returning none for zero repos

nodes.label: Score Renormalization when Validation is None
nodes.norm_label: score renormalization when validation is none

nodes.label: Opt-in Cohesion Gate at Stage 4
nodes.rationale: Ships disabled (clustering_min_cohesion=0.0). Cohesion is logged for every cluster so the natural distribution can be observed in production, then threshold enabled via env var without a code change. Addresses incoherent clusters like 'ADHD task apps + vintage music gear + P2P trade trust' merged under one vague problem statement.

nodes.label: LLM Keyword Extraction for GitHub Validation Plan
nodes.norm_label: llm keyword extraction for github validation plan

nodes.label: extract_search_keywords abstract method
nodes.rationale: LLM path provides domain-specific nouns like 'adhd', 'fintech', 'react-native'. Returns empty list on failure so callers fall back to stopword extractor.

nodes.label: select_keywords async helper
nodes.rationale: LLM path first, falls back to stopword-based extract_keywords on failure or empty result. Public name so debug_keywords.py can import it.

nodes.label: LLM Adapter Connection Pool Leak (deferred)
nodes.rationale: NvidiaNimAdapter and OpenAIAdapter create httpx-backed adapters in scheduler jobs but never call aclose(). Deferred to a follow-up PR.

nodes.label: NVIDIA NIM Client-side Rate Limiter Plan
nodes.norm_label: nvidia nim client-side rate limiter plan

nodes.label: AsyncRateLimiter sliding-window limiter
nodes.rationale: Custom class with asyncio.Lock - no new dependency. 30 lines of stdlib is simpler than aiolimiter or tenacity. Shared across LLM and embedding adapters because both use same API key against the 40 RPM NIM free tier.

nodes.label: Shared NIM Rate Limiter (lru_cache keyed on api_key)
nodes.rationale: lru_cache keyed on (api_key, rpm) ensures one process-wide limiter instance per API key, enforcing shared budget across NvidiaNimAdapter and NvidiaNimEmbeddingAdapter.
nodes.norm_label: shared nim rate limiter (lru_cache keyed on api_key)

nodes.label: build_scheduler() Reuse Pattern
nodes.rationale: Reuses build_scheduler() rather than duplicating job wiring, guaranteeing parity with prod behavior. Calls job.func() once without calling scheduler.start() to avoid scheduling side effects.

nodes.label: C-1: Lifecycle History Slice Bug
nodes.rationale: .order_by(asc).limit(14) returns the first 14 score rows ever, not the last 14 days. After day 14, state derivation becomes progressively stale.

nodes.label: C-2: _extract_brief_id Wrong Attribution Bug
nodes.rationale: Walks entire inline_keyboard and returns the first view: callback found. In multi-candidate messages, a 👍 click on candidate #3 is attributed to candidate #1's brief_id.

nodes.label: I-3: Score Subquery Reads Peak Score Ever
nodes.norm_label: i-3: score subquery reads peak score ever

nodes.label: I-4: Empty-string new_state Written to LifecycleEvent
nodes.norm_label: i-4: empty-string new_state written to lifecycleevent

nodes.label: Forward-Only Migration Policy
nodes.rationale: Never run alembic downgrade. Downgrades drop data-bearing columns and cannot be undone without backup restore. Mistakes are corrected by writing a new forward migration.

nodes.label: Plan D Cutover Runbook (SQLite to PostgreSQL)
nodes.norm_label: plan d cutover runbook (sqlite to postgresql)

nodes.label: SOPS + age Secrets Encryption
nodes.rationale: Private key never leaves the VPS (/etc/devtrend/age.key). GHA decrypts on the VPS during deploy via SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE. Allows secret rotation without manual SSH by editing secrets.enc.env.

nodes.label: DevTrend v4 Opportunity Discovery Pivot Design
nodes.norm_label: devtrend v4 opportunity discovery pivot design

nodes.label: Pain-Point-Driven Candidate Discovery Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Replaces v3 niche-scoring pipeline. Unit of analysis moves from Niche (curated, fixed) to OpportunityCandidate (emergent, persistent, evidence-backed). Produces specific mid-precision app hypotheses rather than generic trending-topic hints.

nodes.label: Validation Curve (original spec §5.2)
nodes.rationale: Non-monotonic: repo_count=0 → 30 (green-field-risky), 1-5 repos no major star → 90 (sweet spot), 6-20 repos → 70, >20 or major incumbent → 30 (saturated).

nodes.label: Extraction Cache via PainPoint Rows
nodes.rationale: Cache is the PainPoint rows themselves, indexed on (source_item_id, extractor_model). Prevents re-calling the LLM on same (item, model) pairs. extraction_state='no_signal' short-circuit avoids repeated LLM calls on empty items.

nodes.norm_label: ci/cd infrastructure design for devtrend v4

nodes.label: Four-Plan CI/CD Decomposition (A→B→C→D)
nodes.rationale: CI/CD lands first (A-C) against SQLite so the safety net exists before the Postgres migration (Plan D) rides the pipeline.

nodes.label: ConsoleRenderer Swap (JSON to human-readable)
nodes.rationale: Primary log consumer is a human running 'docker logs -f' on VPS, not an aggregator. ConsoleRenderer(colors=False) is safe for grep and future aggregators. Reversible with one-line change back to JSONRenderer.
